cases.invariant: The listing-visibility gate passes on the current tree with every allowlist entry matching a real hit
cases.input: node scripts/check-listing-visibility.mjs from the repository root
cases.response: exit 0 with 0 violations and Allowlist: 8 entries, 0 stale.

the gate passing by an exclusion or a whole-file entry

cases.invariant: An allowlist entry permits its literal only in its own file; the same literal anywhere else is reported
cases.actor: Any author of a listings read
cases.input: a from('listings') block ending in .eq('status', 'active') under the contact-event path, another action path and the detail page path
cases.response: no violation for the contact-event path; exactly one violation at line 5 for each other path; no detail-page entry and one contact-event entry with the new fingerprint

an allowlist entry matching by fingerprint alone

cases.invariant: An allowlist entry that matches no real listings-query hit, or whose source cannot be read, is reported stale
cases.input: the current ALLOWLIST plus the old contact-event entry with a repository reader; an entry whose reader returns null; one whose reader throws; one whose fingerprint appears only outside a listings block
cases.response: exactly the old entry from the repository run; each of the other three entries returned
forbiddenEffects: an unreadable source treated as a match
an exception instead of a stale result
